title: GEMglEvalPoint1
description: generate and evaluate a single point in a mesh

messages.description: integer value for grid domain variable i

arguments.description: integer value for grid domain variable i

body: [GEMglEvalPoint1] calls glEvalPoint1() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glEvalPoint in the OpenGL reference.
